status: preregistered; pending external reviewer-agent review because delegation is disabled
external_test_policy: one submission after the final internal five-fold candidate and OOF thresholds are locked; never tune from external metrics
secondary_selection_metrics: record-level macro F1 at validation Youden thresholds

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: whether the baseline overfits because the full encoder learning rate is too high
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: later best epoch, smaller train-validation divergence, stable or improved AUPRC

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: whether faster domain adaptation improves minority ranking before overfitting
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: faster loss reduction and higher early AUPRC without unstable gradients

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: effect of noisier, more frequent optimizer updates at fixed examples per epoch
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: minority-label AUPRC improves if gradient diversity helps

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: effect of smoother, less frequent optimizer updates
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: more stable loss but possible loss of minority sensitivity

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: inverse-prevalence positive weighting with conservative encoder adaptation
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: higher NSTEMI/OMI sensitivity and AUPRC with limited specificity loss

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: isolated loss-function effect at the exact baseline optimizer settings
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: higher minority sensitivity/AUPRC than baseline; specificity and PPV remain acceptable after OOF thresholding

fold0_screen.what_it_tests: interaction between larger weighted gradients and faster adaptation
fold0_screen.expected_if_matters: faster minority learning; reject if loss/gradient becomes unstable or validation deteriorates

promotion_rule.stage_1: run every candidate on Fold 0; reject OOM/NaN, degenerate probabilities, or clear overfitting
promotion_rule.stage_2: promote the best unweighted and best weighted candidate to folds 1 and 2
promotion_rule.stage_3: choose by three-fold mean macro AUPRC, then macro AUROC, minority AUPRC, F1 and specificity/PPV safety; finish five folds only for the winner
promotion_rule.test: ensemble the locked winner's five record-level probabilities and submit once using locked pooled-OOF thresholds

unnecessary_first_round_ablations: sampler or oversampling combined with weighted BCE
full factorial LR x batch x loss sweep before one-factor screening
